_comment: Drives the public docs site at houwert.dev/argus/docs. Each entry pulls a markdown file from this directory, parses it, and publishes it to the marketing site at build time. To expose a new doc, add it here. Categories appear in declaration order; pages within a category appear in declaration order too.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.summary: Install Argus, open your first project, and spin up a session in under five minutes.

pages.title: Concepts
pages.summary: Sessions, worktrees, agents, panels, and runtime views — how Argus is organised.

pages.title: Features
pages.summary: Simulators, embedded browser, terminals, run commands, git workflow, VS Code editor, permissions, and organisations.

pages.title: Automations
pages.summary: Work Argus starts on its own: triggers, signal sources, the autonomy ladder, guardrails, the inbox, and the built-in templates.

pages.title: Project settings — .argus.json
pages.summary: Per-project configuration shared with the team. Setup commands, run targets, terminals, platforms, port allocation, branch protection, and more.

pages.title: App settings
pages.summary: Per-developer machine-local preferences. Theme, agent defaults, editor, telemetry opt-out, and other personal toggles.

pages.title: Telemetry events
pages.summary: Every event Argus sends to PostHog, with payload shapes. Anonymous distinct id only — opt out anytime in App settings.
